name: VALORANT
antiCheat: Riot Vanguard (kernel driver vgk, loaded at boot). On Windows 11 it requires TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot; never propose turning them off, and never disable the vgc/vgk services. Turning off VBS/Memory Integrity is compatible.

configFiles.notes: Resolution and window mode; most in-game settings are stored on the Riot account.

competitiveSettings: Limit FPS off or well above refresh
Material/texture quality low, anti-aliasing MSAA 2x or off
cloudSync: Most settings sync to the Riot account and override local edits.
benchmark: The Range: same route and duration before and after.
typicalBound: CPU-bound on most PCs; very high FPS makes DPC and core scheduling visible.
caveats: Starting knowledge, not verified on this PC. Read the files with powershell-read before proposing changes.
